subject: c-act
title: C.ACT.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-4, paired with v1-p142-1 on the same page. C-ACT (composite activism) is crossed with MT-INFO (music information): the question is what activism — the actual *doing* — has to do with music information, in a section where Braxton names creativity itself as 'doing as a means to celebrate and affirm the vibrational forces that dictate living.' C-CONT (composite continuance) feeds C-ACT, which then outputs to MT-INFO and LK-IMP (linkage implications). MT-INFO branches four ways: a *dashed* edge to TRS (transition) — registering that the link from music-information to transition is conditional, mediated; a solid edge to CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance); to EXT-FT (extended functionalism) → SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars); and to EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics). Structural argument: composite activism's path to music-information is direct, but music-information's path to transition is *conditional* — only the indirect routes through culture-information-dynamics, extended functionalism, and expansion dynamics are guaranteed. This stages Braxton's claim that 'doing' produces music information that becomes culturally consequential through the slower channels of culture-information-dynamics and extended functionalism, not through any direct fast-line to transition.
